Messages.Author: daniel frey
Messages.Body:
Okay, I've been putting together an allies deck. It is basically a
Giovanni deck that uses only one discipline related card: Compell the
Spirit. It seems necessary if you are using more than one ally. The rest
of the deck is a bunch of 2cap vamps to bring out the different allies,
and a tonne of skilless combat cards.

My question is, can people suggest other cards that would help such a
deck. I was able to slap down a Millicent Smith, Vampire Hunter and then
have three minions (my fearless allies) take their actions. It was a fun
card in relationship to my deck. I can think of plenty of cards that
can't target allies (Haven Uncovered, Burst of Sunlight) but I can't
think of many that I can actively use to help my beautiful minions.
Any suggestions?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Memories of Mortality [AH]
Master: 1 pool.
Put this card on a vampire; that vampire cannot attempt to block
allies. Any damage the vampire inflicts on allies is reduced to 0.
The vampire may burn 1 blood during his or her controller's
influence phase to burn this card; he or she then goes into torpor.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
